6 /-! Choose all actual radial triangle charts simultaneously. Internal
7 vertices use their proved flat fans, original vertices are leaves, and
8 one set of frames aligns every reverse-edge pair throughout the tree.
9 This still precedes the proof of global nonoverlap and the cut-surface gluing. -/
10 
11 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
12 
13 open Set
14 
15 /-- Actual local charts with coherent global frames and full surface coverage. -/
16 structure CutTreeCharts {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} (T : P.CutLocusTree a) where
17   fan : ∀ u : T.vertices, (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices → JunctionFan T u
18   triangles : ∀ {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v), PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge
19   at_fan : ∀ {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) (nonvertex : (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices),
20     triangles edge = ((fan u nonvertex).edgeTriangles edge).placed
21   original_leaves : ∀ u : T.vertices, (u : Space) ∈ P.vertices → ∃! v, T.graph.Adj u v
22   frames : CutTreeFrames T triangles
23   covers : ∀ b : frontier P.body, ∃ u v : T.vertices, ∃ edge : T.graph.Adj u v,
24     b ∈ (triangles edge).region
25 
26 namespace SixVertexGraph
27 
28 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
29   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
30     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
31 
32 include graph small_faces in
33 /-- For a cofacial source, construct the entire chart collection and its common frames. -/
34 theorem exists_cut_tree_charts (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
35     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val) :
36     Nonempty (CutTreeCharts T) := by
37   classical
38   let fan (u : T.vertices) (nonvertex : (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices) :=
39     Classical.choice (graph.exists_junction_fan small_faces a T u nonvertex)
40   let triangles {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge :=
41     if original : (u : Space) ∈ P.vertices then
42       ⟨Classical.choice (graph.exists_cut_edge_triangles small_faces a T edge), AffineIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ Plane⟩
43     else ((fan u original).edgeTriangles edge).placed
44   obtain ⟨frames⟩ := exists_cut_tree_frames T @triangles
45   refine ⟨{
46     fan := fan
47     triangles := @triangles
48     at_fan := ?_
49     original_leaves := fun u original =>
50       (graph.cofacial_source_leaf_iff_original small_faces a T cofacial u).mpr original
51     frames := frames
52     covers := ?_ }⟩
53   · intro u v edge nonvertex
54     simp only [triangles, dif_neg nonvertex]
55   · intro b
56     obtain ⟨d, member⟩ := graph.cut_tree_triangles_cover small_faces a T
57       (fun d => (triangles d.adj).toCutEdgeTriangles) b
58     exact ⟨d.fst, d.snd, d.adj, member⟩
59 
60 end SixVertexGraph
61 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
